description: Write content to a file in a Replit project. Creates parent directories if needed. Uses atomic write (temp file + rename) and verifies the write by reading back. For binary files (images, etc.), pass base64-encoded content with encoding "base64".

content.description: File content to write. For binary files (images, PDFs, etc.), provide base64-encoded content and set encoding to "base64".

encoding.description: Content encoding. Use "utf-8" (default) for text files, "base64" for binary files (images, PDFs, etc.).

path.description: File path to write relative to project root

user.description: SSH username — the value before @ in the "Connect manually" SSH command (a UUID)

name: replit_write_file
title: Write Replit File
